title: Her eyes were green stones.
html_source:
This is one of several signs that we have shifted to a new protagonist with a different perception of things.
As Patrick Hastings explain: “… the green stones here in "Calypso” describe the cat’s eyes rather than serving as symbols of irish subjugation under English rule (as in the green gem on Haines’s silver cigarette case)“.
